stories.title: Moscow hit by 'largest ever' drone attack as Russia's election concludes, oil refinery and homes damaged
stories.reason: Ukraine fired more than 1,000 drones and missiles at Russia overnight, with Moscow's mayor saying 450 were shot down over the capital alone; two people were killed and 20 wounded region-wide in what Zelenskyy's forces called an attempt to disrupt the annexed-regions election.

stories.title: Trump cuts short his Camp David trip and weighs a 'big decision' on striking the Houthis after Riyadh missile attack
stories.reason: Trump and top national security officials rushed back to Washington to weigh large-scale military action in Yemen after Saudi Arabia intercepted a ballistic missile over Riyadh, even as Omani-mediated talks in Muscat produced a Houthi pledge to spare American and Israeli shipping.

stories.title: Germany's Merz vows to press on after historic state-election defeat as the far-right AfD surges
stories.reason: The AfD won Mecklenburg-Vorpommern outright while Merz's CDU scored its worst-ever result in any German state, and the Left Party overtook the CDU in Berlin, deepening a crisis for a chancellor whose approval has sunk to record lows less than a year into office.

stories.title: Italy's Meloni vows to ban burqas and niqabs in schools and cap foreign students in classrooms
stories.reason: The proposal, unveiled as Meloni's coalition looks to shore up its right flank, would bar full-face coverings in classrooms nationwide and cap the share of non-Italian-speaking students per class, reviving a fierce integration debate across Europe.

stories.title: Trump says he is creating an 'AI Force' modeled on Space Force and will name an AI czar
stories.reason: In a lengthy Truth Social post, Trump said his administration would resist efforts to restrict AI development while pledging a dedicated task force to 'protect' the industry, offering few details on budget or authority as it succeeds David Sacks' earlier AI czar role.

stories.title: Anthropic says Claude now 'leads' 26% of its own AI research and development, up from under 1% in February
stories.reason: The company disclosed roughly 30,000 Claude agents running concurrently and over a billion autonomous agent decisions in August with only about 0.002% blocked for safety reasons, a striking marker of how fast Anthropic is automating its own frontier research even as it pursues a roughly $2 trillion IPO.

stories.title: US Treasury's Bessent and China's He Lifeng open pre-summit talks on AI, tariffs and critical minerals
stories.reason: The all-day session at JPMorgan's Manhattan headquarters is the final ministerial push before Trump hosts Xi in Washington this week, with negotiators weighing an extension of the Busan trade truce before it expires November 10 and addressing China's lagging rare-earth export commitments.

stories.title: China's CXMT starts mass production of fifth-generation DRAM chips, challenging Samsung and SK Hynix
stories.reason: ChangXin Memory Technologies says its new platform delivers a 50% capacity jump and at least 50% more dies per wafer than its prior generation, cementing its rise from a minor player in 2020 to the world's fourth-largest DRAM supplier and intensifying China's push for chip self-sufficiency.
